limitations: Current OFF branch only; no consent or privacy setting was changed.
Mobile and tablet have one visible app-bar DIV title and a zero-sized hidden H1; this is not a semantic-H1 or accessibility-conformance pass.
The five 나만 보여요 labels belong to five distinct record rows and are not repeated page-level status prose.

publicationReview.privacy: All five images were pixel-reviewed. Only synthetic QA match records and generic settings/disclosure UI are visible. No member list, player name, profile ID, birth date, contact detail, or credential is included.
publicationReview.minimization: Original complete source proof remains local and unchanged. Public proof includes only relevant counts, explanatory text, route, timestamps, image metadata, and bounded conclusions; full DOM, accessibility snapshots, and unrelated account content are not published.
